title: OXVA XLIM Replacement Pod
description:
The
OXVA XLIM Replacement Pod
is a refillable replacement pod for compatible OXVA devices.
Product Type:
Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Built-in Coil)
E-Liquid Capacity:
2mL / 3mL (version-dependent)
Coil Resistance:
0.4Ω / 0.6Ω / 0.8Ω (built-in, varies by pod)
Coil Material:
Mesh
Compatible Devices:
OXVA XLIM, XLIM Pro, XLIM SE, XLIM SE 2, XLIM V2, XLIM SQ, XLIM SQ Pro, XLIM Go
Brand:
OXVA
Coil is built in  -  replace the pod when flavour fades. E-liquid sold separately.
Available options: 0.4 ohm, 0.6 ohm, 0.8 ohm.
